whenToUse: Public-sector, education or community sites that offer readers their own text size, contrast and reading settings.
A display-settings popover or settings page that must change the whole app through the kit's tokens.
avoidWhen: Switching light / dark or brand themes — use the theme axes (ThemeScope, theme switcher) instead.
As a substitute for meeting contrast and text-spacing requirements in the design itself.
a11y: A labelled region; text size is a toggle group with named items, the other settings are switches.
High contrast only remaps kit tokens (muted text to full text colour, hairlines to visible rules) and strengthens the focus outline; settings can persist on the device and are restored after mount.
